text: I managed to get to leavel 731 without spending money, but I'm done. Not only are the ads irritating, but the constant popups telling me to buy coins or items, or play the galactic race or the submarine race are truly annoying. I don't need the popups, I know how to do all that if I want to. Also, it was sometime after level 700 that the game started nagging me to join a team. And you can't just close the demand to join a team. Again, if I want to join a team, I would have done so already.

Updating my review. Thank you for the previous response. I'm at level 3108, and the levels seem to be getting impossible - time is way too short. This is my morning ritual to relax, and I love buying treasure passes and occasionally a booster. However, if the game is so hard to pass that instead of being able to play for an hour in the morning, I can't even get past one level... well now you're gonna lose money from me. I don't make every-level purchases, especially if I feel game is rigged.

2 stars. I'm on level 3,154 and I have really enjoyed this game, however, it hasn't been as much fun for awhile. Once I got to a certain point, it became too hard to where it's no longer enjoyable. The time is so crunched that you have to really hurry and you lose most levels. Plus, there's very little opportunity to get any power ups or coins which you need to pass a level you've spent days trying to complete. The store power ups are way overpriced too. I've moved on to better hole games now.

Zen mode PLEASE! I know you've been asked for this, and you even replied that you like the idea of a relaxing mode with no timer... that was a year ago! It can't be that hard to develop and you could be the FIRST "hole game" to do it... just imagine how many players you would get, because I see them adding on EVERY hole game review board. please just do it! I love this game, but just want to relax without the stress of a timer sometimes. When I'm ready for some challenge and events, then I could

Loved the game at first then I got to level 90 and because it has so many blocks trying at one time with the chips to get into the hole it lags and stops every second to second and half. So much so no matter what I do I run out of time. I used every extra I had been saving to try and until it gets fixed I won't be playing. And of course it happens after I paid for no ads.

So I gave it a 2 because of the bugs. It has issues when transitioning to the main screen after completing a level. It's quite frequent and requires you to force close the game. The other reason is because in game money is seemingly worthless, as well as the power-ups. None of it is required to complete any level. The time limit on the levels prevents the game from getting really fun. An endless mode would be good to add.

Addicting game. But I think it has too many extra hard levels. It is almost every 2 or 3 levels that is extremely hard. It makes it annoying, and I definitely don't want to continue playing a bunch of difficult levels. I also think a good game item to use while playing is a bomb destroyer. There are increasingly more on each level. Sometimes, it is impossible to navigate around them. But like the find button and expand button, ect, it would be useful to have something to help clear the bombs.

I really want to like it. The core gameplay of pulling larger and larger objects into the hole is a lot of fun. Unfortunately, you can't get very far before the timer and the bombs make the game more frustrating than fun. If you want to have leaderboards, competitions, and short timers, have that be a separate mode. Let people just enjoy the game without making it frustrating. I'd pay $1 for small, casual level packs. But there's no way I'm going to pay $ to support this stressful mess

Unfortunately stressful. This could be a nice chill game but, for what I can only imagine was an excuse to encourage real money spending, there is a tight timer and bombs that will instantly kill your run (unless you spend coins to continue). I just want to drag my hole around and gradually eat up bigger and bigger things but, instead, I'm stressed out trying to beat the clock and avoid surprise bombs. There also does not appear to be a way to replay levels which is a little strange.

Almost there. I bought the game to get rid of the ads at a STEEP $10... I was hoping for a bit more as they still try to get me to buy beginner booster packs and stuff. BUT, what I REALLY wished they had was a "zen" mode or something similar where there wasn't any bombs, and no targets. Just a open map where it counts UP and times how long it takes you to complete the level. Don't need it competitive. I just want something low/no stress that I can mindlessly do.

I really enjoy this game & it's a great way to pass the time. A couple of things: Decrease the coins for respawn, 900 is too damn high! Offering free opportunities to get more special items. -increase the time of collecting coins. give 90 seconds -Offer a re-do(at least 1 chance) without having to lose items when you lose a round. -Make the viewing space a little bigger to see the all the items. Or offer a quick 5- second intro of seeing everything all at once and then go back to smaller size. -

This is a fun and addicting game but the costs are way too high for a "free" game. 900 coins for a replay in a game where you get like 10 coins per level is crazy. Some of the "super hard" levels have such a short timer that it forces you to buy more time, it is physically impossible to beat those short times. Add that to the two minute ad breaks that control your phone and open up apps and windows? Predatory. Goodbye.

I paid for No ads. Ads are showing up again. Not only that but once I reached level 150 I am constantly unable to advance to the next level without purchasing things that will help. This game is not only going to take your money just so you can play it, it's also going to continue to play ads even after you have paid for no ads. After giving another chance, this is a pay to level up game. Very disappointed that developers do that. so tired of it.

this game had potential. it's soothing, especially before bed, or it was. I'm on with some bombs, but not when there's huge groups and no way to get your item. but they make it so the hole, even when made bigger befire starting, is too small as they make the items you need bigger. the worst is there's NEVER enough time. this game is made, so you have to buy coins to continue. making it no longer soothing and super expensive as any time anything happens, it's 900 coins to continue.

the overall game play IS good. it's a nice I want to do something mindless for an hour game. I do think there are limitations for how far you can get without paying money for power ups. the game does have a tendency to lag badly on harder levels, it'll fling stuff across the screen when it does this making it hard to find some of the things you need to beat the level. I've also noticed after a certain point some levels are not accurately labeled as Hard. an "easy" level should not need power ups

This a fun game! There are a ton of contests and ways to earn rewards. The ads are infrequent and short. I only have two issues. 1. I wish the animations were shorter (such as when collecting rewards or items you've collected.) 2. I wish you could click next level at the end of a level to continue playing instead of having to go back to the home screen after each level and wait for all the slow animations to finish before being able to start the next level.

Spent 2 weeks playing daily before I decided to purchase the no ads version. The ads aren't too intrusive, just wanted to support the developers. Unfortunately the payment got stuck and I didn't get the benefits for a few days. Customer support helped out and sent extras for the inconvenience. This game runs great on my phone with very little stuttering or lag and is my go-to soothing comfort game. Some levels are hard but there are plenty of free powers ups to help. Rarely run out of "lives" 😊

It's a fun game, I gave it 4 out of 5 because it had a lot of ads, & I had to pay for it to be ad free. However, support is great. The game glitched on me, and I lost all my bonus items as a result. I contacted the support team, and they hooked me up with a thousand hours of lives and bonus items. The game has several challenges to gain coins and free in-game items that help with the boards. I play it often and enjoy it.

This game was fun in the beginning, but racing against the clock got old fast. Some lvls, I have 2.5 mins remaining (incl super hard lvls) & some o/t not hard lvls are impossible. The game likes to cheat too. It puts bombs on top of multiple items that are required to complete the lvl. Swallowing a bomb instantly ends the lvl unless you pay 900 coins to cont. IMO, removing the race against the clock would improve the game. Also, if you pay to continue after a bomb, remove the rest o/t bombs.

I saw a review before I downloaded that said they were on level 800 and I was like I've yet to find a game where I'd play that long and now I'm suddenly on 500. It's just sort of addictive and satisfying and the ads are so minimally intrusive I don't even care which is kind of rare. The only real issue I have sometimes is if I use a compass power up sometimes it never ends up telling me the direction. That really sucks when I use 1800 coins to buy a compass. Otherwise I love it

I really enjoy it! I would like it if there were occasional power ups to neutralize or destroy the bombs, not all the time just here and there like the other ones. Also a few times a bomb would hit just as I start a level and didn't have a chance to move, they was very frustrating to have that happen with no way to avoid it. It is fun and enjoyable, wish the packages cost less money, but that's how most games are. A few times I've noticed the compass not showing locations with I use it.

Over 700 pieces to collect, the square dino ones that are already hard to put in the hole... I had full perks, the super size booster, extra time and large size to start and failed. It only gives 1 minute and 30 seconds without any perks. I'm uninstalling now at level 15,407. Very sick of impossible levels. I tried to give it time for the app to fix the issue, as so many people have brought it up, but nothing has changed and I doubt it will until everyone abandons ship. So I'm out.

A fun little time waster I've been playing off and on for a couple years. I uninstalled it for a bit to take a break, something I've done before. Just reinstalled it and all my progress is completely wiped out. Never had this happen before after repeated uninstall/reinstalls and across a couple different devices. I even tried clicking restore purchases a few times and nothing. Disappointing update and the only reason I don't give this 5 stars.

It's ok, but I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. The first few levels were good, but then they start spamming you with annoying pop ups when you're trying to play. Like mandatory ads between some levels - which I wouldn't mind as much of I didn't constantly get harassed with other pop ups. Today I counted, there were SIX pop ups I had to dismiss before I could get to the actual game. And one of them was a predatory "pay to remove ads" pop up ad with a purchase button you can accidentally click.

Game is fun. Nice art work and level designs & generally family friendly but some game ads can be a bit much for younger players. I want to give this 5 stars but some of the ads are hard to escape from & the homescreen is overwhelming. Way to many activities constantly popping up when I just want to play the next level. Prices are high for no ads or packs. Ad frequency is steady but not overly invasive. If no ads was $5 Id buy it & overlook the busy homescreen. Reward system is good too.

Would be better with a zen mode. Too many bombs and timers. The items you have to swallow defy gravity but the bombs don't. love the game but it takes 100 boards to earn (1500) enough coins for only 1 boost (900). Very stingy with the coin rewards (maybe 20-40) but that makes ppl spend $ and the coin packages are expensive. A $20 purchase will only last about 10-15 levels. It's buy to win.

Fun game with lots of power ups given throughout pkay time. By level 180 I found it difficult to proceed, kept running out of time, I used up all my saved power ups and by 189 there was no way to proceed without purchase... so it was time so say goodbye. Played for months without needing to make purchase... liked it so much that I deleted saved storage and played all over again! No ads!

EDIT: Dropped to 3 stars from my initial 5 star rating. I still like the game, but the time that is given is really short, at times, which makes it difficult to enjoy the game. I get making it challenging but come on! Never get enough coins and boosters. Very frustrating to the point I just want to delete the game, and warn anyone who tries to download to not waste their time! Also, you could add a small notification on the team page to alert you when team members have requested lives.

Very frustrating game. I am over level 7500 and the game has recently added a super black hole. With this boost, they have made the game more difficult by reducing allotted time. Super hard levels are given only 1m30s to complete. If you don't have any boosts are in game coins to extend the time, the levels are nearly or actually impossible. The game has become stressful and irritating, and I'm extremely frustrated. They are really pushing in game coin purchases all the time now.

At first, the game was awesome, but there is a lot of glitching. But the big concern after you hit a certain level, then the game is made so unbelievably hard to pass, forcing you to spend money!! For example, you only get 2 mins to complete a level that needs at least 2:50!! Another example is that the game will glitch and make it look like you're missing one item!! It's all to make money!!

it is a fun game, except it doesn't give you enough time after a certain level. i don't mind the ads, they are spaced out enough that they're not awful, but being forced to spend money on boosters just to pass a level is a no go for me. not a big fan of the bombs either. they can be hidden in piles and I had a few roll into the hole well before my level started.

I have loved playing this game for a couple years. But in the 3 months they have steadily made it impossible to pass any level or receive awards. the daily sub race, can't even get 5 to win. That Galactic race was fantastic then they changed it and you can't pass. I haven't had a bonus coin run in a month. Also they moved the team gardening to weekdays when most people don't play. BUT if you make a large purchase suddenly you never lose, even being reckless and you'll get several coin runs.

It would be great except once in the higher levels it tries to push you into purchasing, either with the boosts, short timers or the bombs... if a bomb rolls into the hole as soon as you start the level it's over and you have to pay 900 coins to restart without losing progress and you only get a few coins each level. or if you get all the items except the last large item and the hole is still too small you need a size boost or you can't pass it. So disappointing not a free game.

Why?!? This was THE most fun & relaxing game at the end of a long day but recent changes have made it so frustrating now! I am above the 4700 level so I have played A LOT but now the timer is too short, the items will not fall in the hole unless you go under them multiple times & there are way higher goals. Absolutely ruined the perfection of this just to force us to pay, which on some levels would get very costly. Guess I will be looking for a replacement game now...so sad!

I have been playing this game for a few months now & absolutely loved it but the last few weeks it has been impossible to enjoy, every level whether it's regular, hard or super hard only gives you 1:40, how do you get over 600 objects in that amount of time? it's become more frustrating than fun. My group dicuss this often, we can't win more than 1 level at a time. What's going on?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?

This game is dangerously addictive and I mean this seriously. I had a hard time stopping. I have to uninstall at level 2110, not because I want to stop playing but because I had 48000 coins and lost them all over time until I hit a level that I can't pass without them. I'm sorry to say that you should stay away from this if you feel it becoming a problem. Fun game, though! The graphics are delightful. Puzzles have enough variation to keep them interesting, so that your strategy needs to shift.

it's a pretty fun game but it has a zillion tournaments/mini game things that mean you have to accept/join/close every. single. pop-up. before you can play a level. and it never fails to show you all the things you can buy to pay-to-win, which you also have to close. the levels are fun, but getting to them is a hassle. I ultimately uninstalled the game.

Game is fun for the first few hundred levels honestly. I'm in the 800's now and it's not fun anymore. The bombs are always on top of the stuff you need and then seem to always fall at your hole. some of the levels are so time restricted that you NEED to have powerups and extra time or you simply can't do it. the black hole is a great feature, but when you lose every other level (like you do in these higher levels) seems pointless. 900 coins is too high for respawn. Fun at first, now it's not.

Buyer--I mean player beware. I played this game because it looked challenging and fun. Man I wish I knew. The higher in level the slower the black hole moves. The items no matter how many items the hole swallowed, many times it was Never large enough to swallow really big items. You want to continue, 900 coins per extra min. (Sometimes min 25.) The game is set up to make sure you lose and pay to keep going. I spent way more than I ever wanted too, NO MORE!! Uninstalled, out of here...

I've beaten almost 3,450 levels. I've absolutely loved the game until recently. The levels have become impossible to beat unless you have upgrades. There just isn't enough time nor enough items to grow the hole large enough to finish the levels. In order to earn upgrades, you either have to earn them from events or pay real money for them. I'm so disappointed that yet again, another company is trying to squeeze every dollar out of their customers. Don't waste your time or your money.

Pretty fun game up till 739. That stage is broken, and the only way to have enough time to pass it is to purchase more time. If anybody knows of a good hack site where the game is cracked just posted here. 1349 also impossible without "extras". Basically need to join a team and hope they win a few tourneys to build up enough extras to extend the time for over a minute. Lucky for me I never see ads, but not progressing, is boring.

some glaring issues. first, when you get the last item needed but a coine or something is falling in it ends up counting it even know the lvl ended, but if the time runs out and the last thing you need is falling in but hasn't fallen all the way it doesn't count? seems a little unjust. second, advertised as no adds. play for a few days, then adds start? what the heck. 3rd lvl 759 is un winnable without paying or having extras. and its not the only one. im all for hard but being forced to pay??

The game is entertaining until you get to a certain point, then the "hard" and especially "super hard" levels become unbeatable without having or having to purchase power ups. Being stuck on a level for several days without being able to beat it brings the playability to a stand still. Combine that with the espensive prices for a only few power ups and you essentially cant play anymore unless you fork over more and more money.

Fun but glitchy, the game will say you missed one item and you'll los even though you've done the level and lost a few times and know for a fact where all those items are and that you got them. Also on the levels where items are on top of boxes or stacked in a huge pile of small items, the lag is immediate and takes up your time. Also on occasion the game won't move even though your toggle is active and it's almost always when a bomb is close to the hole

a great game!! the assets aren't AI ((thank god)) and it worked as advertised!! I have to say, I adore the 3D models! there's a lot of care put into them and tons of varieties! and some levels are genuinely very challenging- one thing I would love is maybe a free play mode? one that doesn't have a timed part, maybe as like quests of specific things u need to find to earn some boosts, cause some levels just can't be completed with out boosts :( but a free play could make more ad money!

The game sucks!!! The time limits are absolutely ridiculous!!! There is not enough to collect everything. The super hard levels are stupid and neatly impossible at times to collect certain items because they throw bombs right where the bombs are placed. When you try to get item where the bomb is, the bomb goes in the hole..The game took 900 coins from me! I contacted support but they are worthless. They didn't reply to my message. I want my coins back!!

Great game, but the ads backfire I don't mind ads—they pay the bills, and I’m fine watching them if they're standard commercial length (30 -60 seconds). But when an ad plays for over 60s with no option to close it, I download the new game and uninstall yours forever. The goal of an ad is to make revenue while retaining your audience. These un-closable ads are just driving players away to your competitors.

As much as I love this game, I am finding that more often when I go to get the daily reward I don’t actually get it. Today was day 3 so it was the extra time. When I went to use it I didn't have it. This is extremely frustrating, especially when you have tried a level multiple times and wait for the reward to play the next day. This glitch needs to be looked into!

I give the game 3 stars simply because of the bombs. After running by them they should blow up at some point. it takes a lot of time and effort to unlock black hole and gain 900 coins for a continue. otherwise great game timer is reasonable not too easy challenging but satisfying as well. either make sliding the hole faster or bombs have a countdown and I'll rate 5 stars.

the game is fun and addictive with no ads. I honestly got stuck playing it all day. and as i got to levels 90smth (pretty sure the game is causing it cuz it would go away as soon as I closed it) my phone started heating a lot. in turn it makes the game lag, basically the collection still works but animation lags. so that causes delays and accidental bombs in the hole, losing for no reason. looks like takes too many resources. also not sure why it wanted access to my drive

So fun! By far my favorite out of all the other similar games. But it becomes absolutely impossible to win after a while without using coins or other upgrades. and you stop winning enough coins or upgrades to keep up with it, forcing you to buy packs. I've been playing for months so I'm at level 3500+ and I'm about to uninstall the game due to how frustrating its become

This game use to be fun. After you get along in the levels, the levels become IMPOSSIBLE to pass without tons of power ups, which you have little chances to get. I don't care what strategy you take, some levels are truly impossible to pass in 1:30. If things do not change soon, I will be deleting this app after playing for over a year. I initially downloaded it for my grandchild, but realized it actually helped to calm me down. Now, it is no longer fun or a challenge due to impossible boards.

I'm past level 2700 if that tells you anything. Completely addicted. The levels are very interesting & challenging & they just keep getting better & better! The developers seem to have no problems coming up with increasingly imaginative & creative levels! It is NEVER boring!!! Update: completely stuck on level 2840, i can't even get close. I've spent too much money here, I'm done spending. It'd be much cheaper to find a new similar game. This will always be my favorite, but I'm done here. :(

When I first started playing I loved this game and enjoyed the daily challenges. A couple updates ago that all changed. Now there isn't enough time to get through a level with $. I'm very frustrated with the game and now only play it maybe once a day. Why did the timers go down so dramatically? This is supposed to be fun, not pure frustration!! What happened to the game I loved 2500 levels ago? This is a general topic of conversation among the groups. Please fix!!

it's fun, but in no way is this a stress free game. your on a timer, tiktok. you have to avoid bombs all over the board. And you have to get only a certain items. never mind doing anything , like knocking down towers and collecting everything on the board without a timer , maybe mow a grass through the hole nothing neat and creative only stress. Even though it is stressful, I do find fun in it.

I love this game but in 2 months I have spent 8000 in gems just to save my win streak. wouldn't be so bad if during the numerous amount of adds I didn't get kicked out of the app and have to give 500 to save my 4 month streak. To many adds to watch for every 2 or less minutes of play you have to watch a 1 to 2 minute add every 3 minutes. The adds ruins the game. I really am thinking of stopping the playing of this game. I've spent way yo much time and money in here already!!!

I have been playing this game for a while now even bought the ad free version which is something I hardly do but I loved this game so much. I am on level 3834 now but I have noticed it has been so hard to even finish a level unless you have the power ups and even then you still don't have enough time it never used to be that hard and it is sadly not as fun as it once was. I would like to add I was not stuck on a level was just stating they have way less time than they should still a fun game

Ngl I'm addicted. My only problem is that there are certain levels where u physically cannot win without power ups. For example level 149, you can eat all the food in the level but you still aren't a high enough level for the biggest thing so you know powerups but powerups are like 1800 which isn't easy. but I'm still gonna play regardless 🫶

It used to be a great game: beautiful design, great controls over gameplay, thoughtful variance in how objects react/fall/physics etc. as one of the top players in the world i'm about to quit. in the past few months there are even basic levels that cannot be completed in the time given without MULTIPLE power ups and paying coin to continue time. seems like they are just trying to bleed you of money now. it wasn't this way for the past two years I've been playing. Shame on All in Hole

The game is fun, but it's a little slow. The hole moves slowly and things drop in slowly. It just lags. Also, the amount of bombs on some levels can be ridiculous. Please give us a bomb shield as an option or a prize, at least. It just gets monotonous after awhile.

I'm really just so sick and tired of being asked to pay to not have ads shoved down my throat while I'm just trying to unwind and play a game. I originally downloaded this game specifically because it was advertised as ad free. And it was for a solid week and then suddenly today...ads. It's a fun enough game I would have kept playing but the bait and switch is wild. Uninstalling.

It's a good game. Others have too many ads. But this one crashes any app I'm trying to listen to. Spotify, Patreon, and Audible all crash. I only play when listening to a book or podcast so I will be uninstalling. If I ever find about about a Zen mode being added, I'll likely reinstall, though.

Updated: deleted @ level in the two thousands. I refuse to continue spending real $ on impossible to pass levels. The higher you go, the harder it is to pass w/o spending $. There are so many bomb balls & short time that it's impossible to pass w/o buying $ for more time or power ups. There should also be some sort of power up that can freeze them for a while or something. Just another money hungry app. This used to be my favorite game but the developers ruin it w/ their greed.

Was great... Until it wasn't. I would love to know how people are on such high levels when I've been stuck on 155 for over a month now. This game went from my go to, to the game that causes me the most frustration. That's when I know it's time to delete. Unless I buy power ups & coins, I'm not getting past this level. 6 wks is enough playing 40xs a day & I am getting nowhere. Uninstall..

I would rate it a 0 if I could. The only way to move forward when you make a potential mistake is to pay money or restart the level. When there are hidden bombs that you can't see and it costs 900 credits (about $2 American) to revive yourself or you start over, which is the only way might I add, it's a sham. I I unfortunately spent some money on this game without weighing the costs and I will take it in the teeth. I WILL be deleting this game and this publisher is now on my blacklist!

Downgrading to 2 stars due to all the pay to win mechanics. Its a good game, but the fact that even when you pay for the app, there is no way to avoid the horrible bomb mechanics just sucks the fun out of it. Everyone is asking for a zen mode, because the underlying mechanics are fun, but they won't do it because they need to drive continuous microtransactions.

I agree with others that the bombs and timers are just to encourage users to spend real money. I have done this a few times. Since the update a couple days ago, the app is crashing frequently. It often crashes when I first open it, as well as in the middle of a game, which is extra frustrating because you then lose the stacked time and size bonuses at no fault of your own. I have no other apps open, no incoming calls or texts, it just stops and closes itself.

I enjoy this game to unwind after a long day. I have experienced a loss/deduction of unlimited lives a couple times now. Today for example, I had 4+hrs of unlimited lives. I stopped playing for a couple hours & came back to only 45min when there should have been 2.5+hrs left. I had noticed this a few times, but thought I just didn't pay enough attention to how much time was there. Now that I'm watching, I know it's definitely happening. This is my only complaint, it's a very fun game.

EDIT: The locking up has been fixed but the bombs are still on top of the items you need to collect for the level. The submarine event had not been fixed. The game is specifically designed to get you to keep paying for boosts and coins in order to keep playing. I already paid to remove the ads but now I find that it is going to keep costing me a lot of money. Nearly 1400 levels in and I'm done with the game. Money suck. Money suck. Money suck. Find a better game to play and save your money

I was enjoying this game a lot until I got to around level 700-800, where the bombs are literally impossible to dodge on super hard levels. This would be fine if you had the option to watch an ad to continue the level. You can only continue playing by paying money or in-game coins, which don't accumulate fast enough. I'd be spending days trying to clear the same level - very frustrating, not relaxing. This game would be perfect if it provided the option to watch ads to continue gameplay.

This is completely a money grab game. The game seems to glitch out but the timer keeps going. So not a glitch, just another way to cheat you out of winning. When earning rewards, game glitches, then you lose your reward. Again seems planned by the devs. Many posts by the devs, seem to be a shock to them, but it just keeps happening over and over. It's easy and addictive in the beginning, but then becomes impossible without purchase. Update: Still the same ol' shenanigans.

I hate that you VERY FREQUENTLY cannot go back to your game after watching an ad. It's insane. I'll run out of time or hit an ad break and when exiting out of the ad I will be sent to the start menu and lose all progress from that level. It makes me want to delete the game. i do not want to spend the money to be 'ad free' just to find out I still experience this problem. I like the game otherwise. I also have no idea what the coins are supposed to be used on. I have 35k of them.

After the last update this game has become nearly unplayable. I don't mind difficulty but it's nearly made it impossible to play without buying coins constantly. I've already paid to remove ads and have purchased plenty of coins on my own Accord. This is very disappointing. It used to be 5 stars. Update- they seem to have fixed the issue. Quick response from them as well. thanks!

Great additive game that doesn't allow for progress to be saved. I lost ALL progress and purchases today when I had to uninstall and reinstall the game due to a bug that rendered it unplayable. If and when support actually answers me to restore progress and purchases, I'll update my review. using the "restore purchases" button does nothing. and this game has 0 way to log in and save progress. which is wild because it has over 50000 levels!!!!!

I played this game a LOT and was very happy with it. I spent a good chunk of change on going ad-free and when I was out of lives, etc., etc. Recently, however, it seems levels are virtually impossible to complete unless you spend money. I assume they've tracked that I have spent money in the past and will therefore be likely to cough it up to get past a level now. Capitalism, I get it, but I'm no longer interested. Some company needs to figure out a game I can just buy once and play casually.

It's an addicting game, definitely a good time burner, but some aspects are frustrating. The power-ups aren't very useful and are way overpriced. The stars you earn after levels don't really matter because you can't go back and play old levels again. Small/thin items sometimes glitch into the floor so you won't know they're there unless you use the compass or move directly underneath them. An endless mode would be pretty fun. I think adding more frequent coin levels would help justify prices too

It really grinds my gears that this app closes out when I leave the game to send a text. I have it running in the background, so this shouldn't happen. It's so annoying, I've lost perks because I had to open another app. It's a fun and challenging game, but that part is very aggravating. I would also like to mention the bad placement of the power ups. You can't keep them as your thumb can easily hit one due to it being at the roaming area. They should have been on the top.

At first, I loved this game. But now I'm at level 1350, and the fun has been sucked right out of it. Hard and super hard levels are more frequent, and if I manage to grind through ten levels (after multiple tries) to get the super black hole, bam! Here comes a level that's just about impossible, and I lose it. Then I'm stuck for ages, because I don't have money to sink into a game. Add a zen mode, no bombs, no paying for boosters, no time limits, just fun.

NO STARS. I will recommend anyone to download other black hole games before this one. Playing games are designed to ease your mind and give you a sense of comfort. The more you play it, this game purposely puts tactics and places for you to fail, in order for you to spend money. Go online and see how much revenue this game has made compared to their profits from last year or in previous years. It's a difference between playing a game that is challenging and one that scheming you, slowly.

I love the game and I have been playing for months. I broke my phone and got a new one redownloaded this game and signed in and it's back to level 1....ugh I was on level 715ish and now have lost everything. I have emailed support and tried the chat with us with no response. extremely frustrated because I really like the game but I will not be playing again if my progress is gone.

This game is fun and visually appealing. I gave it 2 stars because of the dishonesty. Many times, you will have to pay to advance, using the same beginning hole size, time limit, and moves. I have purposely played the same level the same way many times and lost. The moment I paid and I played the game the SAME way, with nothing else changed, I advanced. Screen record your gameplay if you download this game to see what I mean. I will be contacting the developer to voice my concerns.

I really enjoy playing the game in down time but I have noticed that when it comes to the levels with the little boxes holding items it tends to freeze up or slow down the game greatly. I've been able to get through many levels with it but currently at a level that many of those that causes it to be very difficult bc of the lack of control during the freezing and while the timer is still going my circle is not moving very fast. I would enjoy it much more if this particular issue were resolved.

This was supposed to be a cute twg (time-waster game, pronounced "twig"), but the silly thing has way more to offer! The colors are bright and happy, they use a mix of 80's/90's nostalgia and current food fads that keeps things interesting, and they're generous with ways to earn power-ups without having to spend cash. The levels have all been incredibly varied. "Hard" means "hard", and there are added challenges of all kinds all at once.

I purchased a package, money was taken form my credit card, and I never received the items and the coins. I tried to chat with customer support using the internal chat in the application but there's no keyboard available to type. I'm almost at 800 level and I'm done with this game. Another thing I noticed is the black hole slows down when it's close to timer running out. It's like something deliberately stuck the hole so I can't beat the clock and get the last few items in the hole.

Needs a colorblind setting, or able to skip a level like this. I'm currently stuck on a level that I may never pass, because I'm supposed to sink a certain color of some items- tiny leprechauns and bells, that have all the other color variations of that item also on the board. The colored part of those items is too small and minimal that I can't tell with my colorblindness. It doesn't have enough time for me to randomly sink everything, hoping I'm getting the right ones.

I would give 5 stars, however. the last day I've been leaving the game and coming back to the same level over n over. I have beaten multiple times now and it is an extra hard level. I start out with zero extras and have run through almost all of my "won" extras trying to pass this level each time. I lost events bcuz I joined a finish 7 levels and end up losing because I can't pass the level every time. I've probably passed an additional 25 to 35 levels after this one but just keep ending up here

I enjoyed this game at first, but it lags while playing, which makes it difficult. It also has pop-ups for prizes and notifications, but they are unclickable and cover everything else on the screen. I just installed the latest update, and the game is unplayable because a gloved hand is pointing at something on the side, but nothing is there, and I can't make it go away so I can play. If these weren't consistent issues, I would give it a higher rating.

I love this game. They make the levels attainable and purchases feel worth it. However, there was an update that made the items somewhat see-through? And.. I hate it. I don't see an option to turn it back. EDIT: They fixed it!! :) It's officially a perfect game again. ❤️ Update: I'm still playing this game. I've succumbed to the gameness. I'm on level 7818.

To many Hard/Super Hard almost every other level, before you can collect boosters that might actually help. Timers are too short. Bombs 💣 are 💩, often sitting on top of items needed to finish levels so you can't see said items, & getting the Bombs 💣 off is often near impossible. Play for free game is geared towards needing to purchase items to get through many levels, which is a waste of money because the Bombs 💣 negate most of the boosters. Would be fun game with less Bombs/time limits.

If you could actually play the game, it would be 5 stars. Nothing is consistent. you have 3 identical items you are supposed to get. two will fall in the hole just fine. but then the next one will just sit there. won't move at all. Something always happens to make you lose a life. I had one board, where the very last item was the last thing on the entire board, and it would not fall!!! Add to this, that you have to wait 30 minutes to get a life! I am a busy person. I only have 30 mins!

I don't know how this game has a 4.9 once you go to see all reviews you will see how many of them are low. we all have the same issue.... I have zero issue paying for a game. but this is by far the most expensive pointless game I have played. the greed of the devs on this one is real.. I am good but since level 150 it's impossible to play more than 4 games without either paying or losing your streak and later on after 500 even $10 a week is not enough for them.. deleted and done!

This game was fun until I got to level 90! It did a little glitching here and there but nothing that was too bothersome. Once I got to level 90 and had to go through big piles of blocks with bags of chips on top it became so glitchy the hole wouldn't move and it just kept freezing up. I tried several times but there are too many hole in games to choose from to be dealing with glitches and I've played at least 5 others and NONE of them glitch like this one does. Unfortunately I'm uninstalleding:-

I have played this game for over 2 years. I really enjoyed it but with the new changes, it is impossible to beat certain levels without boosts. It's so obvious on certain. levels with the amount of time you're given. Its sucked up all of my $ that I earned. Giving up and deleting. It was fun while it lasted!

at first it is fun to play. after you get in the higher levels. they at a lot of bombs to get you. an then they shorten the time. that forces you to buy more coins if you want to pass the level. I like the game but I'm not gonna pay every time I want to pass a level. so I'm out. I'm deleting the game right after I post this.

I absolutely love this game. I'm on level almost or over 8000! But, I've sent emails to appsupport and have been ignored the last 2days. I'm stuck on loading screen. This is the 2nd time. The 1st time, I got an answer and fix almost immediately. This time, nothing. Very disappointing for as much $ I have spent on this game.

I love this game but the heart levels are almost impossible to beat unless you spend money they're harder than the extremely hard level which it shouldn't be that way. it brings the level of fun way down when you're stuck on there for days trying to get past the level I would recommend that after so long that maybe start giving people things to help beat the level so that they can progress further more people would probably spend money if that was the case.

It's great in some ways and bad in others. The bombs and timer make you think, but lvl 215+ might be impossible w/o paying money (or maybe a TAS). Ads are surprisingly chill, but self-ads are not. Being ad-free and then not is weird but ok. Playing bomb chicken is fun but bomb ontop of needed items is kinda mean. Do I want to recommend? Not really? Am I resetting my progress to play it again? Yes... And it's one of the best mobile games I played...

It's a fun game, no ads. What my critique is about getting ripped off after purchasing an item. I made my selection and the game restarted the payment was debited but I never received my items. I tried reaching out to the developers but they didn't respond, I then asked Google Play for a refund and they denied it. I've bought other items from them successfully but this last time I was burned so I won't buy anything from them again.

Glitches and seems like ur not in control sometimes when it moves on its own. Glitches way too much and moves slower so ur time runs out and forces u to use up ur power ups and time extension. No longer can enjoy this game. Uninstalled the game thinking it was my phone but it wasn't. Reinstalled the game and same issues ever since it updated.

Currently on level 6435. Its fun when u 1st start playin but no worries once u reach the level Im on it loses its fun factor. Every other level is super hard, u cant win w/o power ups & coins 2 get xtra time. I noticed they even changed the 0.99 cents limited edition pack that got u 5,000 coins & 1 of each power up, now its $4.99. I know cause that was the only time I purchased. Its as if they do everything n their power 2 prevent u from leveling up unless u pay them money.

I love the game! Best graphics out of any black hole game Period! MY favorite game. I play it everyday! Also can be challenging at times but I'm glad it's not just some super easy game either! ABSOLUTELY Nobody's graphics compare to this game. I also love that there are new levels affiliated with the time of year or the holidays and new stuff to see and do.

NO-ADS BREAKS GAME & PUSHES MICROTRANSACTIONS! Instead of No-Ads improving gameplay, it breaks the game because you can't continue without coins, which push microtransactions because you'll use them all after 1 or 2 revives and take a long time to accumulate more. Timers are too low to complete without continues or grinding reattempts to the point of memorizing level layouts, and bombs are placed on required components causing fails or large time losses to edge them away.

I love this game! Made it to board 8003 with over 10,000 coins but the game somehow transferred from my iPad to my phone which is small so it makes it difficult to play. I sent multiple emails, with no response. I have invested in this game with yet no response! It’s heartbreaking to depart from something you real enjoy! A response would have been respectful! My rating is definitely a 1.

Money Suck!! Normally, when you spend real money, to purchase a $10+ package.. you can play & benefit from it for a couple of hours (at least). Not the case with this game!! A $10+ purchase, only kept me playing for 20-25 mins. I feel ripped off!!

Absolutely love this game! It's fun and not overly hard, but there are a few levels that are almost impossible without using power-ups or playing an additional 60 seconds. It's still a super fun game, and in just a month or two, I'm already close to level 5000, so I play a decent amount. 😅🤣 Also, support is quick and amazing! Michael from Support was fantastic, btw!

I used to love this game, but lately it has become more stressful than fun. With one loss,I can lose all boosters, coins and black hole making it nearly impossibly to pass a level because there is just not enough time. I can be stuck on a level for days, missing out on helping my team with challenges. It takes way too long get back lost coins without spending actual money. I find myself going to other hole games just to relax. When a game is too hard, it is no longer fun.

This game was so much fun to the point of being addictive up until I got around level 700. Then it slowed way down. Levels became un-winnable without boosters. Not enough time, too many objectives, bombs everywhere, including right on top of the things you need. It stopped being fun and just became frustrating and stressful.

I liked the game, until I got to level 124 or something around there and ran out of time because I had consumed everything on the map except a bomb, spent the last minute going all around to make sure, but my hole still wasn't big enough to consume the two required objects. In order to pass that level I would need to purchase a power up to make the hole bigger than the objects in the level allowed it to be after consuming everything. I uninstalled it instead.

It was fun to play until you could not pass the levels without buying extras, tools or coins when the timer ran out. Then it sucked. I'm downgrading this from three stars to one star. They throw a nasty little trick in there that throws up a choice to spend coins when you think you're going to exit the round. So instead of trying again, you end up spending 900 coins on something you didn't want to do. That's absolutely deliberate.

Game starts ok but quickly devolves into a crowded mess. The game say lawn mowing but after you mow two small lots it turns into a city building game where you have to drive a truck back and forth to get building supplies in random numbers. The absolute worst part is little icons completely covering the map that cause a pop up when you hit the that wants you to spend money. They're impossible to avoid. Driving around is hard enough since you have an extremely narrow view.

so, I never leave reviews, but this game is actually pretty fun. I tried it yesterday and played 76 levels so...😅 It's kinda relaxing to just collect a bunch of food items in a hole. the graphics are nice and gameplay is fun. though there are transaction offers, they don't blast you with mass micro transaction offers like some games. even better, there aren't any annoying ads every minute. I'm having a good time... thumbs up!

If I could rank this game in the negative I would. I reached level 149 and could absolutely not progress any further without making a purchase! It is 100% a pay to play game. I have screen recorded that level with no more items on the floor, but one. A giant cake. It wouldn't fit (lol). But that means my hole (lol again) had no way of consuming that cake unless I were to pay to buy upgrades for size! For shame, HOMA! FOR SHAAAAAME!!! UNINSTALLED!!!!!

Money drainer... I've spent so much money on this game that I wish I could get back. Every item in the game is $1,800. The game freezes up, and it throws the bombs in the hole, so you have to pay 900 or sometimes 1900 or 2900, which drains all your coins in seconds. This game has cheated me out of so much money. I probably spent over 400.00 dollars on this game over the course of time. I loved the game, that's why I kept playing it, but good grief, it cost me a lot, so I sadly deleted it.

Very fun game, few (if any) ads, and the items are bright and semi-realistic. It's a fun and satisfying way to pass the time. My only complaint is that it frequently says I lost the level even if the last item went fully into the hole. And if I answer a text or call during a game, it shuts off and I lose the level even if I had it on pause. I also wish there was an optional ad or a wheel to spin for extra coins. Otherwise we get stuck playing a level 50 times in a row. Otherwise, great game!

I have been wanting to play this style of game for a while as it seems quite relaxing, this one is the only version that has been worth the time/download. I agree with other reviewers that the lack of ads (early on at least, I am at level 30) and the great art style are strong pluses. We'll see if the later levels will need money spending. Two things I would like to see are a) an 'endless' relaxation mode and b) a reward for clearing the board in time, instead of penalizing stars for time taken

(Level 749 currently) I really enjoy this game, it's a great way to pass time or try to relax. The reason I didn't give 5 stars is, I think it needs to have an option to watch an ad to get coins or items. Even if it was limited to 5 in a day, that'd be fine. I have an issue that when I lose a level and all of the bag boosters are lost, it's so much harder to beat an already difficult level, and yeah you can use the size & time boosters, but if I continue to lose, I will eventually run out..

Great but time limits make it not fun. I'm about level 140 and I have to retry every level at least 3 times because I always run out of time. The game is great, looks good and is fun, but it's annoying to constantly fail every level. I assume it's part of your monetization model to make it so you *have* to use paid power ups to get through the levels, but I'm not doing that. I'll just uninstall.

I absolutely love this game. No annoying ads constantly, levels are fun, plenty of prizes. Calming and cute! EDIT: By the time you get to level 140 it is impossible to pass without using multiple items. I was having fun until the stupid extra hard levels ruined it. I have played the same level for days and can't get past it even using multiple items. I'm so annoyed I am about to uninstall.

This game is super addicting and I love that you can go ad free. But the game has some issues that need to be fixed. The helps reset to zero constantly (not just weekly), there are no notifications when a team member is asking for help, and I've lost a life a few times when a level opens with the previous screen frozen over the top of it and I have to exit. Other than that, it's a pleasant game. Some levels may seem impossible to pass but they aren't, you just have to find the right strategy.

I played this game for a while and it was a lot of fun. It has only a few ads, and it has fun gameplay. I just deleted it due to a glitch, where after a certain level, my coin value went from over 4000 to -2500. I played for a little bit after this, but after progressing past a certain point, the game has nothing else to offer. It is simply rinse and repeat. Wish they would offer continuous challenges past level 150-200. Fix the bug that sets coins to negative value, and it would be much better.

Love the game and am very addicted. That being said, I buy coins to get extra lives and save myself when I run out of time or get bombed but frequently I'm having a problem where I play a level and the screen will be covered with the start menu and the joystick so I can move the hole around but can't see anything. I lose all my progress and have to start the board over.

It's a fun game and all, but the timer and the bombs are driving me insane! Add a little extra time. And, please... for the love of your own body... GET RID OF THE STUPID BOMBS!!!!!!!!!!!!! I am sick and tired of getting an automatic lose after getting a bomb in the hole. If you can't get rid of them, just come up with a different penalty, like losing some of the items or something, instead of just automatically losing the entire level. It's incredibly annoying. Other than that, the game is cool

I found this game in an ad in a different game and I love it, haven't stopped playing for several days! The game uses a system where you need lives to play levels, but you can also win prizes that give you unlimited lives for a period, sometimes 2-3 hours. Which is great, except then I can't stop playing! The ads play sometimes after you complete levels which is way less intrusive, compared to games that interrupt play or make you watch ads for power ups.

Was a very fun and enjoyable game up to a certain point. Some levels just don't give you enough time. Also there seems to have been a recent addition that adds bombs onto the field that just immediately make you lose, and there's TONS of them, it makes the game very frustrating when its so hard to avoid them. I did not download this game to have to weasel my way around obstacles, i downloaded it to suck up objects into a hole.

Well.... I'm on level 1615. I love the game I would have given yall a 5 star rating, but I have played many, many, levels over and over and over again the levels repeat and it should be new levels everytime especially when people spend money on it. I spent a little on it, but once I figured out the levels just repeat, that will not happen again.

I really like this game, but now it's becoming a money pit. The time needed to get the hole built up to accommodate the items needed is longer than the amount of time given, which then means one needs more coins or boosters to finish the levels. It's not just the hard levels, either, but the regular levels also. That's swiftly becoming frustrating, and will probably lead to uninstalling, which is too bad because as I said earlier, I really like this game.

This game is impossible and shows the massive issue with time limits in games. So when I say this game is impossible, I don't mean it can't be played. Cause it can. However as the game goes on it becomes impossible to score 3 stars in any level. It takes 2 minutes to get the hole large enough to grab some bigger items and you only have 2:30 to beat the level. So by the time your able to you can only get one star, unless you blow all your power ups. Which are too limited for it to matter.

Edit:The response to the issue is for us to buy an ad free experience? That's incredibly disappointing and low key offensive. It WAS fun. I got a few levels in and then all of the sudden they had to have ads after every little thing you do.Use it if I need boosts or power ups but don't interrupt game play. And don't let them lie about how this is necessary to pay for the app. There are plenty of free to play apps that don't absolutely kill a game with the forced ads between each level.

Decided to stick with it up until level 225. I discovered that at that point or slightly before, it is literally impossible to beat certain levels without having extra tool stuff & even then, one has to have enough tools to beat the extra hard levels. Each level gives way too little coins, so in other words one can't get ahead without paying money & the packs are way too expensive. After a while, it's not a true competition of ability, but a competition to see who has the most money to spend.

Was really enjoying this game. Even spent money in it. Very addictive game for me THEN ... it started landing objects required to finish the board out of bounds where you are unable to get to them. Also ... the ask for lives option was VERY glitchy. HOPE they work out all the issues and release All-In-Hole 2. No way to contact customer support. Deleted game. Not worth it.

I like this game it's a harder game than the other hole games with the danger items. Also having to just getting certain items is way different than the other games. I do wish the view of the board was a little farther out so I could see more of the items a little faster but I guess that would take a bit of the challenge out. good graphics and very challenging. love the no commercials part the most

Great game, but it's evident that the developers are also the top players. The time limit for earning three stars feels too short, and the cost of power-ups is excessive—you need to play 30 games just to earn 900 coins. Without spending real money, progressing is impossible. While I understand the need for monetization, the game doesn’t introduce anything particularly new. It’s enjoyable, but the cost-to-reward ratio feels unbalanced. I used to play frequently, but now I rarely play this.

Not perfect, but I've sunk a hundred hours into the first ~1,100 levels without spending a penny, so that's worth 5 stars. It's a fun, easy time-waster with the occasional tough level that makes you really think about optimizing your route. There's a skippable ad every few levels, which feels fair, and a few too many popups - but usually about ways to earn free items. The game gives you far more items and money than you'll ever use, so there's no pressure to spend real money.

Edit. They introduced ads. Not too bad yet, but I don't hold hope. Can pay to remove, but I already spent money on the game to thank for not having ads, so I'm bummed. The game is buggy, even with the latest update. Now the levels are harder with killer bombs everywhere. Not as fun. Original. (Just for not having forced ads. Omg thank you. Also a decent time killer.)

Really fun physics in a 'katamari-like' game! Like lots of games, you get rewards for winning on the first try, but it's not so punishing to lose that you want to give up. It seems like the developers put a lot of thought into the balance of the levels. Totally worth playing without paying, but the quality is such that I was happy to do so. Please keep up the good work! I will say that I've lost a few levels due to glitches/ freezes on my Pixel, but not enough to discourage play.

Game frozen, it is locked on the screen that says hole in one. Game won't open at all. I checked for updates and cleared my cache and I still can't play. What a shame I like this game. Update, the game is working now. I like this game but I think you should have more chances to get extra coins or bonus objects. Update, too many bombs too many glitches. I finally deleted the game and downloaded a similar game.

It has the best graphics of any of the other hole fill games I've played, but this is definitely a pay to play game. The boosters are so expensive so sometimes you wait days to get what you need to beat 1 level. When you're getting ahead on hard levels, the screen freezes but the timer runs out and the hole won't get big enough to obtain the last 2 items no matter what. The most frustrating part is to get the last item and then a bomb appears and falls in and you've lost. Uninstalling!

I loved it until the 'super hard" levels. There are no easy way to gain advancement and the paid for options are a RIP OFF. There have been multiple times the game froze with the level screen blocking my ability to play. Meanwhile stealing a life and all (paid for mostly) tools or bonuses I wanted for that level. I want to love this game. But I've certainly never gotten back what I've legit paid for.

Fun game that has clearly been developed well. It is well polished and everything works. My main beef is the ad-free package. $10 is definitely an overreach, especially for a game of this type that doesn't have a great amount of depth. I'd be a buyer at $5 or less all day long, but for $10 I would just as soon deal with the ads until I just get fed up and move on to something else. Just my 2 cents 🤷‍♂️

I loved this game starting out. It didn't feel like the other games like this that you couldn't get past the first level. At level 133 all of a sudden I couldn't pass the level without a purchase. The fact that there aren't any video ads to view for extra time would be fine if it didn't cost 900 coins for 30 extra seconds. That drained my coins after just a few rounds. This app has a lot of potential but it needs some serious work first. I'm deleting and will check back in a few months.

Was one of my favorite games! I've spent a lot of money to get passed some of the trickier levels. After the 3rd or 4th time buying coins to get an extra 30-60 sec to finish a level the game times me out after 5 sec, literally 5 sec! So then I'm forced to either start over or spend another $1.99 to finish the level. At this point I don't know if it's a bug or what. After taking time off for a while due to frustration I started playing again today. It happened again. Guess I'm done 4 good now

This update is a HUGE downgrade. I know ads are what keeps games up and running, but I was hoping they'd at least be less intrusive and not last literal minutes at a time between every ither round. More than that, the obstacles have been removed, making the challenge of an already easy game go way way down by eliminating any danger of a one hit KO or the objects getting bigger. The game used to ve addictng and now I find it boring. Uninstalling.

This game is a good time killer, but if you change phones without knowing info from the old phone, you'll lose all of your progress. They don't have a progress recovery feature like most games. I was offered to have it manually recovered, but again, I don't know the info from a broken phone. I had too much progress to start over, so I'm deleting instead.

This game is so much fun, so addictive!!! I played it for about 6 hours one night. I loved playing it so much. The levels later are challenging, with lots of fun themed extras to pick up which give you little bonuses, to get you out of tricky spots. I'm only giving for stay 4 starts as, I really wish I could continue playing it, but, once you run out of coins and have used up all your bonuses, there is no way to get more. You must pay real money to buy more.

This game is addictive but I am over how even the regular levels are hard to pass. Sometimes even harder than the ones that say hard. They put in these mini games that if you fail a level, you have to start over, but it's impossible to pass the level first time. Also, I spent money to get past a hard level, played two more levels, and then it put me back to the level that I spent the money on. I sent a message to team support and didn't even get a reply. I will be deleting now

I really enjoyed this game at first. It is a good mind numbing game and in the beginning, it's fairly easy and I really enjoyed it. I do try to support games and got a package of upgrades, but it got to a point where that was the only way to progress. Some complained about the ads, but they only occur between levels and were not overwhelming. My suggestion: give the ability to watch videos for upgrades or add time. I'm close to deleting the game due to getting stuck without spending real money.

Edit: A way to skip an occasional extra hard level would fix it. I really should've listened to reviews a little better. This game is addictive, but it's designed to have levels unbeatable without spending money. I've spent probably $15 so far, but I just gave up on a level that was impossible even after spending coins. It's a common pattern. Fun to get you hooked then sunk cost to keep you spending. Not saying I'll never play again, but this pattern is too familiar.

This game is kind of fun to play, but after the first few easy levels, it becomes prohibitively expensive. You essentially HAVE to pay $$ to continue, typically around $1.35 respawn or to buy 60 sec more time - which you will probably have to do 3 or 4 times on most levels. If you're skilled you might make it a few extra levels but they will keep adding difficulty until the $ target is met. Get real. I'm not willing to pay $100 to play your stupid game for a couple hours. UNINSTALL.

The actual gameplay is fun. You go around and suck things into your black hole, getting bigger as you go to consume bigger things. However adds start at level 35 and it's got so many in game events "compete for five levels, get these items in maps, join a guild" etc. I just want a zen game where I can just chill out. Not feel like I have to keep playing to get more items for Impossible levels.

I liked the game until I got over about level 85. The bombs are obnoxious.
